map.→ 打开二手车保值率/残值计算工具: -> Open the used car value retention / residual value calculator tool
map.二手车保值率/残值计算 使用指南: How to use the used car value retention calculator
map.以「购车价 20 万、车龄 5 年、里程 8 万 km、合资品牌、车况良好、年基: Take as an example a purchase price of 200,000 CNY, 5 years of age, 80,000 km, a joint-venture brand, good condition and 20,000 km of annual benchmark mileage
map.保值率为何逐年加速下降？: Why does the value retention rate fall faster each year?
map.做 5 年持有成本测算：把每年预测残值连乘折旧系数，估算总折旧损失。: Work out the 5-year cost of ownership: multiply each year predicted residual value by the depreciation factor to estimate the total depreciation loss.
map.卖车时根据车龄、里程、品牌与车况反推当前合理估值，避免被压价。: When selling a car, back out a reasonable current valuation from the age, mileage, brand and condition to avoid being lowballed.
map.模型用 retained(age)=0.85×0.91^(age-1)，即首年保: The model uses retained(age)=0.85×0.91^(age-1), i.e. about 85% retained in the first year and multiplied by 0.91 each year after, a compound decline; depreciation is fast in the early years and slows later, which matches the actual residual value curves of most models. It is only an empirical estimate, and in reality it is strongly affected by new car price cuts, policy such as emission standards, and market supply and demand.
map.购车前估算某车开 N 年后的残值，对比不同品牌/车况的保值率，辅助选车与卖车决策: Before buying a car, estimate its residual value after N years and compare the value retention across brands and conditions to support both buying and selling decisions.
map.输入购车价、车龄、里程、品牌与车况，按贬值曲线计算当前估值与保值率，并预测未来: Enter the purchase price, age, mileage, brand and condition to compute the current valuation and value retention from the depreciation curve and forecast the residual value over the next 5 years.
map.里程系数怎么算？: How is the mileage factor calculated?
map.预期里程=年基准里程×车龄；实际/预期>1（超里程）时系数下修，最多降到 0.7: Expected mileage = annual benchmark mileage × age; when actual/expected > 1 (over mileage) the factor is lowered, at most to 0.70, and when actual/expected < 1 (under mileage) it is raised, at most to 1.05. The more the overage, the larger the residual value loss, which is exactly the theoretical basis for charging excess mileage when returning a leased car.
map.：保值率系数：车龄保留率 retained(5)=0.85×0.91⁴≈0.58: : value retention factors: age retention retained(5)=0.85×0.91⁴≈0.5829; brand factor joint venture=1.05; good condition=1.00; mileage factor mileageFactor=benchmark 100,000/actual 80,000=0.8<1 -> 1+(1-0.8)×0.05=1.01. Residual value=200000×0.5829×1.05×1.00×1.01≈123,600 CNY, and value retention=12.36/20=61.82%. With a domestic brand (0.90) on the same basis, the residual value drops to about 106,000 CNY, showing how strongly the brand affects retention.
